name: Print queue
description: A print queue the household shares: add models from their pages, a grid or the board itself, see who has what queued or printing, drag each print to Printing, Printed or Failed, and keep the history.
author: Thingport contributors

screenshots.caption: Opened from a model's page: the household's prints on one board, that model's own outlined, and Add model waiting at the end of the queue.
In the dark theme, your own card's menu: move it up or down the queue, on to Printing, Printed or Failed, or give it a note.
Add model opens Thingport's model picker: tick a few and they join the end of your queue.
Filtered to one person in the dark theme: what Dad has queued, printing and failed, with his notes.
